about: For the papers behind the most figure-read simulation curves: did the authors release the numbers? Read from the papers' LaTeX sources and the data pages they point to on 2026-10-20; each entry gives the sentence, the address, whether it was reachable from here, and the licence where one is stated. 'table-in-eprint' means the numbers are in the arXiv source of the paper; 'catalog-public-recompute' means the simulation's catalogues are public but the plotted numbers are not (they would have to be recomputed); 'on-request' means the authors say the data are available on request.

entries.quote: main.tex:1001: The data supporting the plots within this article are available on reasonable request to the corresponding author. A public version of the \swift\ code is available at http://www.swiftsim.com. The swift-emulator framework used for the calibration is publicly available, see \citet{Kugel2022}. The \flamingo\ simulation data will eventually be made publicly available, though we note that the data volume (several petabytes) may prohibit us from simply placing the raw data on a server. In the meantime, people intereste
